LESSON: INDIGENOUS KENYAN CRAFTS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.10: Indigenous Kenyan Crafts

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Indigenous Kenyan Crafts
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is clay the preferred material for pottery?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe coil techniques in pottery
2. model a vessel using coil method

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe coil techniques in pottery

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe coil techniques in pottery.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model A for “describe coil techniques in pottery” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe coil techniques in pottery” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe coil techniques in pottery" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: model a vessel using coil method

Teach
• Today’s focus: model a vessel using coil method.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “model a vessel using coil method” using a school example.
• Model B for “model a vessel using coil method” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "model a vessel using coil method" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe coil techniques in pottery
• Model 2: model a vessel using coil method

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe coil techniques in pottery
2. Practise: model a vessel using coil method

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is clay the preferred material for pottery?
2. How is a fabric woven?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe coil techniques in pottery
• model a vessel using coil method

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
